verdict.rationale: The Delaware Division of Revenue collects and stores taxpayer data through its portal, so whether that data may be used for AI training is a fair privacy-posture question. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an AI-training opt-out, a data-use policy, or any AI-related privacy control. The items only cover filing formats, payment and licensing services, and probes for machine-readable endpoints.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
